args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after its deploy. As per runbook, rolled back all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is TBD; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging prior to rollout.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failed health checks in production

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Executed a rollback of checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (the rollback required and received change-manager approval).
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failed health checks in production") documenting the rollback and recovery; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging, which suggests the v2.3.1 issue may have been detectable pre-release — worth investigating in the incident follow-up.
